Overview

Relevant source files
  • PLAN.md
  • README.md
  • evolution/__init__.py
  • pyproject.toml

The Hermes Agent Self-Evolution project is a standalone optimization pipeline designed to systematically improve the performance of Hermes Agent It leverages evolutionary search and reflective optimization to refine the agent's internal components—ranging from high-level instructional "skills" to low-level tool implementation code.

By treating agent components as optimizable parameters, the system produces measurably superior versions of the agent through automated iteration, validated against rigorous constraint gates and performance benchmarks.

Purpose and Scope

The primary goal of this repository is to provide a "self-improvement loop" for Hermes Agent without requiring manual prompt engineering or GPU-intensive training README.md5-7 It operates as an external supervisor that:

  1. Extracts current agent components (skills, prompts, tools).
  2. Generates evaluation datasets from synthetic data or real session history.
  3. Optimizes those components using the GEPA (Genetic-Pareto Prompt Evolution) engine or the Darwinian Evolver.
  4. Validates candidates against size limits, semantic drift, and test suites.
  5. Proposes improvements via Pull Requests back to the main hermes-agent repository README.md11-24

System Relationship

Hermes Agent Self-Evolution lives in its own repository and operates on the hermes-agent codebase. It is not a dependency of the agent itself, but rather a developer tool for continuous improvement PLAN.md3-5

Core Optimization Engines

The system utilizes three primary engines to drive evolution:

EngineOptimization TargetIntegration
DSPy + GEPASkills, prompts, and tool descriptions PLAN.md11Native Python; uses reflective analysis of execution traces README.md26
Darwinian EvolverTool implementation code and algorithms PLAN.md12External CLI; treats code files as "organisms" README.md67
DSPy MIPROv2Few-shot examples and instruction text PLAN.md13Native Python; acts as a fallback optimizer PLAN.md73
